verdict.rationale: stagewise is an agentic IDE, so the MCP-client axis applies. Its docs describe a plugin system that gives the agent tools such as GitHub (repos, issues, PRs, actions), Supabase (queries, edge functions, migrations) and Figma (designs, selection monitoring), with plugin commands exposed via slash commands. That shows external tool integration, but none of the evidence names MCP or says users can add arbitrary servers. Missing for 10: explicit MCP client support, documentation for configuring custom or third-party MCP servers, transport/config details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
